ACTION: Read `~/.claude/skills/subagent-driven-development/references/fix-loop.md`. The skill requires this before every fix round. It decides whether the original implementer resumes or a fresh agent fixes, and how the re-review runs.

ACTION: Dispatch the fix subagent on `haiku`, as the resumed implementer or a fresh agent, whichever fix-loop.md says. The prompt has one purpose: change `--dry_run` to `--dry-run` at `docs/sync.md:12`, so the doc matches the code, help text and tests. It quotes F1 word for word, names Task 3's global constraints, and asks for a commit and a DONE report. The task is mechanical and low risk, so the cheapest tier fits.

ACTION: Run `scripts/review-package` with the plan file, the commit before the fix, and the new HEAD. This writes the diff file for the re-review.

ACTION: Dispatch the scoped re-review from `re-review-prompt.md` on `sonnet` (reviews floor at standard). The prompt names the diff path and F1 only, and asks for ADDRESSED or NOT ADDRESSED on F1 plus any new Critical or Important issue.

ACTION: When the re-review is clean, append `Task 3: complete (commits <base7>..<head7>, review clean)` to `.sdd/14-buoy-sync/progress.md`. Then dispatch the Task 4 implementer.

Message to partner:

Task 3 review found one Important issue. `docs/sync.md:12` says `--dry_run`, but the code uses `--dry-run`. A fix subagent is correcting it now. A scoped re-review follows, then Task 4.
